# Wiktionary reference-layout regression fixtures

Captured without modification from the English and Japanese Wiktionary
`action=parse` APIs on 21 October 2026 for the Japanese word 飲む:

- `en-nomu-spelling.html`: <https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/飲む>, English Wiktionary contributors.
- `ja-nomu-spelling.html`: <https://ja.wiktionary.org/wiki/飲む>, Japanese Wiktionary contributors.

These third-party extracts remain under Wiktionary's Creative Commons
Attribution-ShareAlike terms: <https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/>.
Revision/cache identifiers are retained in the original API HTML comments.
They are test data, excluded from runtime and release packages.
